text: Hilltop is a robot facsimile of a Cylon Centurion created by Spectre, an ambulatory cybernetic sentience that assumes command of the garrison on Antila after ever reptilian Cylon dies as a result of that planet's diseases. As with Spectre's other creations, Hilltop is named after an attribute of the planet Antila, however Hilltop outgrows its programing and achieves a state of sentience that disturbs Spectre; Spectre's eventually hopes to disassemble Hilltop in order to determine the nature of Hilltop's uniqueness. Eventually, when and Kyle's numerous army of children drive the Cylons off Antila, Spectre orders Hilltop to accompany him to the remaining Cylon ship on Antila. Hilltop refuses, saying that it should stay behind to help his other Cylons; Spectre disconnects its internal power source and leaves with another Centurion facsimile. Unbeknownst to Spectre, Hilltop made modifications upon itself, thus bypassing the wiring that connected the powerpack to its systems. It reactivates and orders Treebark to surrender to the humans on Antila. Hilltop and its fellow Cylon facsimiles instead help the Antilans rebuild their colony, surviving an execution attempt by Kordel in the process (The Young Warriors).

The is a weapon camouflage skin featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts. It is one of the 3 camouflages earned through Clan Wars, therefore not affecting the unlocking of Gold Camouflage. It is earned for all weapons once a clan the player is in gets to level 23.
Portia is first officer in . She is described as being a "tall, powerfully built woman."

Dr. Jalapeño Plepper is a dentist. He gives lollistops to child patients. He appeared in only one episode, and has a Spanish accent. He resembles a green chili pepper. He owns an intimidating looking drill that chased a bear away in "The Lollistops". Chowder became addicted to lollistops and lost his teeth in order to get another one. When Chowder arrived at Dr. Plepper's office, his teeth that he stole from The Toothporium scared Dr. Plepper. He only wanted him to show him where the lollistops were. Then Chowder spits his teeth out, and wrecks his office. After that he started to cry. He is voiced by Carlos Alazraqui.

"The Weirdo That Haunts Your Dreams" is an odd blue giraffe-like creature with glasses, clothes, a beard and office chair wheels for feet. He only appeared in "The Sleep Eater" so far. He states he "haunts Chowder's dreams".

A Juggernaut Suit is a piece of equipment seen in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0, Call of Duty: Black Ops 6, and Call of Duty: Mobile, and usable in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Call of Duty Online, Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty: Heroes, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.

was a blue dragonborn wizard in the School of Necromancy, and a guest ally of Vox Machina. As a necromancer, Gern could animate the dead and keeps undead thralls, such as Carol, Coral, Fatty Arbuckle, and Stimpy. Gern was played by special guest Chris Hardwick.

Frumpkin was the familiar of Caleb Widogast. Although he is actually a fey creature capable of assuming many forms, Caleb usually summoned him in the form of a Bengal cat. As a companion, he was controlled by his summoner, Liam O'Brien, with assistance and communication from the Dungeon Master, Matthew Mercer.

A gelatinous cube is a transparent ooze composed of mindless, gelatinous matter in the shape of a cube. The average gelatinous cube measures 10 feet to a side and weighs as much as 15,000 pounds. The creature is completely transparent and dissolves living tissue with its acid.
The is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
Green dragons are master manipulators. They roam through forests, manipulating creatures to gain power and wealth with as little effort as possible.

is an orsimer dragonknight who serves as bartender at the Dreary Jug (later renamed Grelnok's Skull), which she owns collectively with Hoa, Mallory, Slaughter, and Tavima. She is played by Laura Bailey in Blackwood miniseries.

Hags are usually malevolent witches presenting as old women with exaggerated features. Most are fey, though the night hags are fiends. They are known for making deals with desperate people, toying with their fates and feeding on their misery.

The KL03-Trident is a Directed Energy Weapon featured in the Exo Zombies map Descent in the DLC Reckoning of Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. It is a crossbow-like weapon that fires bolts that bounce off walls and hit zombies multiple times. Its destructive power is amplified when Open Fire is active or battling in cramped and confined space.
Dr. Frida de Rolo was a wizard that was part of an expedition from Wildemount, and became the founding lady of Whitestone.
Ghouls are corporeal undead driven by hunger for humanoid flesh, distinguished from zombies by their greater intelligence and paralyzing claws.
Dame was a warrior and a former member of the Barrowguard. As an NPC, Gaya is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

The KN-44 (known as the ARAK in the alpha build and ARK-7 in the beta) is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III and its prequel comic, as well as in Call of Duty: Mobile. It was also planned to return in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 but was replaced by the KN-57.

Hotis was a rakshasa initially found pretending to be a dwarf named Hosin, the manager of the Velvet Cabaret in Vasselheim. Half of Vox Machina, as well as Thorbir Falbek and Kashaw Vesh, were contracted to hunt him in . He was slain, with Vax'ildan's killing blow accompanied by a taunt. Hotis eventually revived and later tracked down Vax in Whitestone. As an NPC, Hotis was played by Matthew Mercer.
Mystic Iotha is the leader of the Wisher pixies that lived in the Moonbrush. As an NPC, she was played by Matthew Mercer.

:For Lolth's chosen assassin, see Jourrael. is a fire giant living in the City of Brass. She is known for her gambling skills, which she has used to amass a large collection of valuable items, including the Plate of the Dawnmartyr. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

The Kill Counter is a piece of customization in Call of Duty: Black Ops III. The feature is unlocked after prestiging one's weapon. Thereafter, the kill counter will appear on the left side of the player's gun, and will kill keep track of the player's kill count with said weapon. The kill counter starts before the player unlocks the gun; if the player picks up a weapon or uses it in gun game before unlocking it, kills with the gun will still count.

Ichabarr is the headless stallion-lord of the Herd of the Damned, a herd of skeletal centaurs that roams the Parchwood Timberlands of northern Tal'Dorei, in the adventure hook Legend of the Headless Horse-Man in the Critical Role: Tal'Dorei Campaign Setting sourcebook, set in 812 PD. In Headless Horse-Man, set in 836 PD, Ichabarr and his centaur skeletons similarly continue their activity in the region, spiriting away young bachelors. So far, Ichabarr has not appeared nor been mentioned onstream.

Luneskon is a female gnoll and the High Shaman of the Moonsteeth gnoll tribe of Rootgarden Marsh. In an adventure hook in the Tal'Dorei Campaign Setting and Tal'Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, she manages to twist and tangle one of the arcane ley lines in the center of the marsh, ceasing the function of all arcane magic within a radius of one hundred miles. So far, Luneskon has not appeared nor been mentioned onstream.

Nergaliids are rotund, scaled, frog-like devils, sometimes found in Xhorhas. According to the book The Fiends of Folklore, nergaliids were alleged to feed on people in the night while they slept. Their ability to drain life from those around them can also allow for their victims to be transformed into mutilated, zombified corpses, whose skin and muscles fell away, leaving a shambling set of bones and organs that attacked without much visible intelligence. Kylre, a member of the The Fletching and Moondrop Traveling Carnival of Curiosities, was a nergaliid posing as a lizard man until he began feeding openly.

The KN Weapon Platform is a popular open-source series of weapon designs that appears in Call of Duty: Black Ops III and mentioned within the Data Vault. It is incredibly popular worldwide due to its cheap cost, customization, and reliability. An example of an assault rifle made from the KN Weapon Platform is the KN-44. KN-42A3 and KN-43A3 versions are also mentioned within the Data Vault. In Call of Duty: Black Ops 4, the new another weapon from the KN series named KN-57 can be used with the game. The weapon KN-44 from the KN Weapons Platform also appears in Call of Duty: Mobile.

is an aging Dunmer sorcerer who serves as cook and chef at the Dreary Jug (later renamed Grelnok's Skull), which he owns collectively with Grelnok, Hoa, Slaughter, and Tavima. He is played by Taliesin Jaffe in Blackwood miniseries.
Merfolk are amphibious humanoids with the lower body of a fish.

Father Milo Cowst was a priest of the Dawnfather during the Calamity. As an NPC, Milo is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan. Milo was a mortal avatar of the god Asmodeus, the Lord of the Nine Hells; however, he disguised himself as Arcadia Cerenvetorix during the Fall of Aeor, and the Milo known to the other Prime avatars was in fact merely an illusion.
The is a bolt-action sniper rifle featured in Find Makarov: Operation Kingfish and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
is a druid of the Circle of the Hunt with the ability to travel between the Material Plane and the Underworld.

Osysa is a gynosphinx chosen of the Knowing Mistress residing beneath the Slayer's Take guildhall in Vasselheim. As an NPC, she is played by Matthew Mercer in Critical Role, by Alanna Ubach in The Legend of Vox Machina, Season Two, and by Laura Bailey in The Re-Slayer's Take.
the Hunter was the Shaper of the beastfolk and a god of the wilds in Aramán.
The KBAR-32 (referred to as AR57 in the game files) is a Kendall Ballistics bullpup assault rifle in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.
Ropers are monstrosities. They are ambush hunters, taking the appearance of a stalagmite while waiting for their prey to get close.

Stimpy was a skeleton animated by the necromantic powers of Gern Blanston, serving with his fellow thralls Carol, Coral, and Fatty Arbuckle. As a companion NPC, Stimpy was played by Matthew Mercer, but he followed the instructions of Gern's player, Chris Hardwick.

The Swavain basilisk is a type of sea serpent, related to common basilisks, that is found in the Swavain Islands and elsewhere in the ocean around Wildemount. Rather than petrifying creatures with its gaze, Swavain basilisks excrete an oil which is capable of turning creatures to stone. Swavain basilisks often hunt and nest near shipwrecks.
The KBS Longbow is a Kendall Ballistics bolt-action sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.

Sehanine, the Moonweaver, is a chaotic good deity of moonlight and the autumn season, the patron of illusions and misdirection, as well as the goddess associated with the tides due to her lunar attributions. Widely worshipped within halfling and elven culture, she is largely considered to be the deity of love and protector of the trysts of lovers. Those who work in secrecy and trickery often ask for her blessing. While both moons are her domain, Catha is widely associated with Sehanine, possibly as her creation, and there are those who believe the red moon Ruidus is ruled by another god or power. As an NPC, The Moonweaver has been played by Matthew Mercer in Critical Role, by Liam O'Brien in Liam's One Shot: The Song of the Lorelei, and by Brennan Lee Mulligan in Exandria Unlimited: Divergence.
is a halfling monk working for the Archive of the Cobalt Soul, a library in Zadash. His monastic tradition is the Way of the Cobalt Soul. As an NPC, Tubo is played by Matthew Mercer.
Queen Titania is an Archfey of the Feywild, and the Queen of the Summer Court.

The Karma-45 (referred to as CRB in the game files) is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It has built-in dual magazines, allowing the weapon to have tactical faster reloads. The Karma-45 resembles the Vector from previous games, but appears to be double-barreled.
Tritons are aquatic humanoids with ties with the Elemental Plane of Water.
is a half-elf elementalist mage and a member of the Ruby Vanguard. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.
is a barbarian woman and a mortal avatar of Gruumsh, the Ruiner. As an NPC, is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Senior Lieutenant Khoa Le is an antagonist in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and member of the Settlement Defense Front. He's assigned to the SetDef warship Deimos. Le is killed by Nick Reyes in a dogfight during Operation Blood Storm.

Vex'ahlia, nicknamed Vex, is a half-elf ranger / rogue member of Vox Machina. She is played by Laura Bailey. Born in Byroden, she and her older twin brother Vax'ildan were raised there by their mother Elaina until they were taken to live in the elven city of Syngorn at the direction of their father, Syldor Vessar. She and Vax'ildan were unhappy, and left in their early adulthood to be on their own. In their travels, Vex'ahlia rescued a bear cub, Trinket, gaining a loyal animal companion. During her adventures with Vox Machina, she became the wielder of the legendary bow Fenthras to fight against the Chroma Conclave and earned the blessing of Pelor, becoming the Champion of Pelor, to face Vecna. After her marriage with Percival de Rolo she took his surname and became Lady Vex'ahlia de Rolo. In later years, she became a member of the Tal'Dorei Council and had five children.
A Wisher pixie is a small, winged, fey creature. Vox Machina encountered Wisher pixies in the Feywild.
is a human wereboar living in Barinak. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.
The Justice is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty Online. It can change from a fully-automatic assault rifle to a designated marksman rifle, which changes its name to Justice DMR.
was a sorceress who led the wood elves after the Divergence.
is a powerful elven mage who is the owner of the Open Quay district in Nicodranas. He resides in the Tidepeak, a magical tower in the Open Quay. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.
Yetis are hulking monstrosities that stalk alpine peaks in a ceaseless hunt for food. Their snow-white fur lets them move like ghosts against the frozen landscape.

Kickback is a Common gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, found upon certain weapon variants. It allows a variant's magazine to become replenished should the player earn a kill with the last few bullets in that magazine.
Amethyst, Princess of Gemworld is about the average pre-teen girl, Amy Winston who is teleported into her favorite faulty videogame to assist the characters inside.

The Karabin (referred to as the Kbsp 1938 in the game files) is a semi-automatic sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: WWII.

Catwoman is one of the most iconic characters in the DC Universe. Beginning her career as an excellent thief, she has always been one of Batman's greatest foes. Later on, she would change her alignments to become the epitome of an antiheroine. Catwoman is an exceptional martial artist with great gymnastic abilities and outstanding combat skills, making her a a force to be reckoned with.

{{Disambig | Image = | MainPage = Garfield Lynns (Prime Earth) | AltID = Ted Carson; Garfield Lynns; Bridgit Pike | ImageText = Garfield Lynns | Era1 = New 52 | Description = The Firefly is a legacy name used by three pyromaniacal super-villains in the DC Universe. His obsession with fire was the result of an abusive childhood. He has been a member of the Secret Society of Super-Villains. Harley Quinn is a former psychiatrist at Arkham Asylum who went mad for the Joker and joined him as his sidekick and girlfriend. Using very colorful outfits, Harley is one of Batman's greatest adversaries and a very dangerous enemy to deal with. Her gymnastic abilities, endurance and agility make of Harley a formidable opponent while her mental instability makes of her a very unpredictable agent of chaos. All in all, there's no denying that Harley's qualities makes her very alluring.
The KN-57 is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. It was developed in Russia by the fictional manufacturer FREDEK. It also has an MKII variant along with 2 Mastercraft variants.

The Juggernog Bottle is a special item featured in Blackout within Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. It is used to unlock "Tank" Dempsey as a playable character within Blackout.

The Huntress is one of the DC Universe’s most prominent urban vigilantes. Although the mantle has belonged to two different ‘Helena’s, she has endured as a purple-clad, crossbow-wielding urban warrior, located in the space between Batman and Catwoman, and inspired by personal vendetta against injustice. Helena Wayne, was the daughter of Bruce Wayne and Selina Kyle, who became a vigilante in the footsteps of her parents initially to prove her mother’s innocence. Helena Bertinelli, one of the DC Universe’s most renown antiheroes, was instead the sole survivor of a mafia family massacre who, after years of martial training and studying her enemy in exile, returned to Gotham with a vengeance, as its “Nightmare to the Underworld”. In the dark of night, the Huntress keeps her watch over Gotham and stalks the monsters that lurk in the shadow.

The is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.

He and his followers, among whom is his trusted and gothic assistant Dala, feed upon the blood of captured victims. He is notable for being the second super-villain to face Batman in publication history as well as the main antagonist of the Dark Knight's first two-part storyline. The Mad Monk was created by Gardner Fox, Bob Kane, and Sheldon Moldoff, and first appeared in (1939). | Gallery = File:Batman 0525.jpg| File:Monk Earth-One 02.jpg|

Poison Ivy was a former botanist, who suffered a terrible accident which caused her body to change. Ivy acquired an immunity to all natural toxins and diseases. However, the accident left her mentally scarred as well and she developed a hatred towards mankind, especially against men. Her new powers, combined with her new ideas, turned Ivy into an eco-terrorist, capable of creating complex plans to damage people in favor of nature. Ivy would normally try to gain profit from rich people who damage the natural environment, but at times she has been known for trying to reach a balance between humans and nature. Most recently, Ivy's powers have expanded: her skin turned green and she was able to control large mutant plants of her own creation. Despite her attractive nature, Ivy is a very dangerous enemy and has caused Batman all kinds of troubles. Sometimes working as a force of good, but most times working to destroy Batman's patriarchy; Ivy's ultimate goal is to free the Earth from humanity and restore nature's rightful position.

The are a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. They also appear within Finishing Moves in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

{{Disambig | Image = The Question All Along the Watchtower Vol 1 2 Textless Variant.jpg | ImageText = Renee Montoya | MainPage = Renee Montoya (Prime Earth) | Era1 = The New 52 | Description = The Question is Vic Sage, the vigilante protector of Hub City. He is a great martial artist and detective, an investigative reporter in his civilian identity. The mask he wears to disguise his face is made of an experimental material called pseudoderm. Sage is driven by a deep personal quest for philosophical meaning, which has taken him through both Objectivism and Zen; in some versions, he is portrayed as a paranoid conspiracy theorist. Aristotle Rodor is his closest friend and mentor, although his teachers have included Richard Dragon and Lady Shiva. Myra Fermin is his most frequent love interest.During 52, when Sage was dying of lung cancer, he trained Renee Montoya as his successor and she eventually replaced him. Sage has been a member of the Justice League, the Living Assault Weapons and the Black Lantern Corps. Montoya frequently works alongside Batwoman against the Religion of Crime and has also done work with the Birds of Prey.Following Flashpoint, the identity of the Question become Narcissus and became a member of the Trinity of Sin. Vic and Renne would later be reinstated following Rebirth. The Question was created by Steve Ditko, and his first appearance published by Charlton Comics was in Blue Beetle Vol 5 #1 (1967). Originally a physics professor working at Ivy University, he develops equipment to shrink himself to subatomic levels using white dwarf star material. Eriana-3 was a member of the ill-fated fireteam led by Eris Morn tasked with the assassination of Crota. She and everyone else in the fireteam died, leaving Eris as the only survivor. Eriana was also a Praxic Warlock and the owner of Eriana's Vow.
Leonine Courser is a legendary Sparrow. Leonine Courser can be dismantled to generate Glimmer.

The is an aircraft carrier used and made by the Imperial Japanese Navy. It is featured in the campaign of Call of Duty: Vanguard in the level The Battle of Midway where it is destroyed along with the Soryu by Wade Jackson.
Lord Jorum was an Iron Lord who his companions joked was more wolf than human.

Osiris is an old Warlock who was exiled from The City, due to his obsession with the Vex and the Infinite Forest, and was said to have "come too close" to understanding the Vex. He has knowledge about the inner working of the Hive, as he knew about the Shrine of Oryx.
Phylaks, The Warrior was a member of the House of Salvation, and one of Eramis' council members. She was hunted down and killed by the Guardian in the Well of Infinitude.
The is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. It was added as part of the Season Two update.
Tazaroc, the Sun Eater was a Psion Flayer that served in the Red Legion. She represented Solar energy within the Psion Flayers.

Alaaks, the Beast Tamer was a Fallen Captain and the leader of a gang of pirates. She and her crew were hired by Eramis, the Shipstealer, to hunt the relics of Nezarec on behalf of the Witness. She was encountered in the Pirate Hideout: The Beast Tamer activity.

Chelchis, Kell of Stone was a Fallen Kell of the House of Stone who lived on Riis in the years leading up to the Whirlwind. She is remembered by modern Fallen for her bravery in standing against the Hive and the Black Fleet during the Whirlwind, holding the attackers at bay so that her people could escape Riis.
The is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II. The Kastov 545 is also available in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III as part of the Modern Warfare II content carryover.

Chroma-Admiral Rafriit was a military leader of the Ammonite species in their war against the Hive after they broke through the Fundament atmosphere. He was a skilled master of war, pushing Xivu Arath's forces and Savathûn's ships back to the sixth of Fundament's fifty-two moons, and placed them on the defensive. Shortly afterwards, he moved to protect the Leviathan, drawing his attention away from the Hive. Rafriit was later killed, along with his people, by Xivu Arath when Auryx returned from the dead. His corpse was impaled by Xivu Arath and used as a temple.

Daazaz Dar, Unbowed Legion was a powerful Cabal Centurion encountered in the European Aerial Zone during the Solstice event from 2019-2021. They would fight alongside Mouvurg and Shogmar, serving as one of the commanders of a group of Red Legion deserters.

Descendant Axis Goblins are an Elite variant of the Vex Descendant Goblin. They can be distinguished from their Minor counterparts by the dark grey parts of their frame, and possess increased strength and health.
The is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.

Evaluator of Savathûn is a Taken Minotaur encountered in Expunge: Delphi. The Minotaur is summoned by Quria, Blade Transform to maintain its Taken Rotational Shield and safeguard an Authentication Key.

Hasaak, Venom of Xivu Arath is a powerful Hive Wizard encountered in the Broken Courier Mission. They were tasked with defending a relic in the Gardens of Esila, which was successfully stolen from the Awoken, before they were killed by The Guardian.

Ir Absuul, First Aria is a Hidden Swarm Deathsinger seen in the Choir of the Damned Mission, where the Wizard along with her coven and leader, Ir Airâm, Deathsinger, would be hunted and killed by The Guardian to gather their essence in hopes of creating the Deathbringer.
The is a semi-automatic sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

Jana-14 was a Warlock and researcher in the employ of the Vanguard. She was assigned to a team studying Thorn, but was slowly corrupted by her time on the project and began experimenting with the weapon on her fellow researchers.

Liadris was a Ghost who was partnered with an unidentified Guardian. She was considered very down-to-earth by her Guardian and was regarded by him as his friend. After her death, Liadris' Guardian was left lonely due to having few other friends and missed her terribly.

Mazan, Lost Captain is a Fallen Captain of the House of Dusk, who is encountered as the main boss of the Widow's Walk Lost Sector, a secluded plaza within the Trostland. Like most of their counterparts, Mazan will be armed with a Shrapnel Launcher for ranged combat and pursues Guardians in a swift and aggressive manner.
Kite & Xi Industries is a vehicle and weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Mobile.

Shogmar, Unbowed Legion was a powerful Cabal Centurion encountered in the European Aerial Zone during the Solstice event from 2019-2021. They would fight alongside Mouvurg and Daazaz Dar, serving as one of the commanders of a group of Red Legion deserters.

Servile Wizards are a common Major variant of the Taken Wizard. They are highly aggressive and resilient, quickly summoning Shadow Thralls whenever they see a foe. They can be distinguished by the spikes on their backs and their golden hue. They first appeared in the Destiny 2 version of the King's Fall Raid.

Solkis, Kell of Devils was the Kell to the Fallen House of Devils. Solkis led the House of Devils at the Battle of the Twilight Gap. In its aftermath, Solkis was hunted down and killed by the legendary Guardian Saint-14, who bashed his skull in with a headbutt.
The is a marksman rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

Sledge is a Titan, who competed in the Guardian Games with his fellow Titans Ladrillo and Vasara-5. To prepare, they created a training course using target dummies and white paint as pools of radiolaria. While Sledge ran the course, Ladrillo fired at him to create a "high-pressure environment".
Thalia was a Lightbearer in the Dark Age who worked in a crew with The Drifter, Otto, and Ayrin. She disliked using guns and preferred to kill her enemies face-to-face with a knife.

Techwizard Malykuh, Salvation's Warden was a powerful Fallen Captain of the House of Salvation, before they were corrupted into a Wrathborn to serve Xivu Arath, God of War. They were sent to assault the Bray Exoscience facility on Europa, in order to corrupt the Clovis Bray AI.
Kilo Reiner, abbreviated as KR, is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. Their logo is a reversed K alongside an R, all capitalized and stylized.

Tlamus was a mighty Cabal warrior, whose story was recounted in a popular tale. When the Primus called for the strongest warriors to serve, the district knew she would be the one to go. This attracted the attention of two weaponsmiths, Dhutus and Gharhet, who sought to outfit her with their gear in order to gain fame. Tlamus would thus start recieving gifts from the two, in the form of a war axe, a Slug Rifle, a Shotgun, and a helm adorned with antlers. When Dhuthus challenged Gharhet to the Rite of Proving in order to end this feud, the latter appointed Tlamus as his chosen. Upon the day of the duel, Tlamus presented herself to the battlefield wearing Gharhet's colors. She then had no trouble slaying Dhuthus with one of the many terrible weapons she had been gifted.

Voice of Riven is a Taken Chimera that served the Taken Ahamkara Riven. It is the final boss of Forsaken story campaign and appears in the Nothing Left to Say mission, where it devours Uldren Sov after he unwittingly opens the way into the Dreaming City.

Wrathborn Knights are Hive Knights whose minds have been altered by Cryptoliths, turning into Wrathborn to serve Xivu Arath, God of War. Their corruption renders them completely mindless and enraged, causing them to behave more erratically than regular Knights, moving faster and fighting more aggressively. They are distinguished by the green aura around their head. On occasion, their death may release a Well of wrathful energy, which allows one to temporarily damage the shield of stronger Wrathborn.
The is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.

Ykriis was an Eliksni and the father of the Captain, Kethiks, the Yet-Proven. Little is known about him, only that he once challenged a Guardian to single combat and came out victorious, draining the Light from the shell of their Ghost.
Brother Ghaine the Healer is an NPC in of Diablo III. He is found in the Hidden Camp, where he provides healing services.

Clawed Gorgons are a type of Nightmare monster in Diablo Immortal. They are found in the Misty Valley on Mount Zavain. They can also be found in the Silent Monastery dungeon. They attack by spitting shadow bolts at the player.
The is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. It was added as part of the Season Six update.
Dark Bersekers (a.k.a. Pain Mongers and Manglers) are demons in service of the Coven, and enemy type in Diablo III.

The Deadwright is an elite monster seen in Stormpoint in Diablo Immortal. They are members of the Cult of Terror. They are normally seen in charge of Terror Adherents and Terror Zealots and provide support by summoning demons or parts of greater demons to attack an enemy.
Denysov is a doormaker who resides in Yelesna. He can be found north of the town's waypoint in a back alley.

The K&S Red Dot is a red dot sight featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for all weapon classes, excluding Pistols.

Dubnal is an NPC in Diablo IV. He is a healer located in Braestaig.

Eugwenie was a Blood Knight stationed at the Gea Kul Chapterhouse. She killed her would-be vampire master with a lance after her induction. She removed the lance to find its blade with a glow that never faded. At a point, she took the lavish armor of the priest Ruda, who she struck down during a Shardborne conversion ritual.

The Kepler Microflex is a reflex sight featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for all weapon classes.
The Gloam is a variant of the Willowisp. They are the smallest and weakest of these spirits, appearing at a mere four feet tall.
Frydehr was a Crusader. In battle against his foes, he was heavily wounded, near death. However, he was able to channel his wrath, apparently saving himself.

The Khazra , otherwise called Goatmen or Goat Demons, and formally referred to as Aries Vehemens are a race of mutated humans that have taken on the appearance of bipedal goats and follow the orders of their demon masters. They wield axes, polearms, swords, and magical staves to attack their enemies.

The Kepler Red Dot is a red dot sight featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for all weapon classes, excluding Pistols.

Kekegi was a member of the Monks of Ivgorod. Known for his wisdom, his spirit never once wavered during his legendary Five Trials. His indominatable will infuses the headgear he wore during the trials.

Kehr Oldwyll is a of the Stag Tribe. Kehr is eight feet (2.4m) tall. His body is muscular and scarred. He is fluent in the trading languages of Lut Gholein, Skovos, and Therat. He wields a greatsword named Scorn and wears a bearskin cloak, while his legs are girded with piecemeal plate and mail armor. He wears oxhide boots.

Muck Spawns are monsters featured in Diablo Immortal. They can be found in the Underdeeps of Southern Dreadlands. They attack by spitting poison and launching poisonous and volatile insects at the player.

The K&S Thermal Holo is a holographic sight featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for all weapon classes, excluding Assault Rifles and Pistols.
Tale of the Warg Nobleman is a piece of writing pertaining to a nobleman, seeking the ability to transform into a wolf/wolf-like creature.

The Sanguine Duelist is a Rogue dedicated to Lilith. They subvert townsfolk through subterfuge or violence. Gifted with blood blades, they insure a swift end to anyone who gets in the way of their dear Mother's plans.

The Undone Bilespewer is an Aberration monster encountered in the Library of Zoltun Kulle in Diablo Immortal. They are a combination of demon and beast. The Bilespewer attacks players from range, spitting globs of bile/acid from its tail at enemies. At close range, they will claw at their enemy.

The Kepler Pistol Scope is an optic featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for Pistols and is unlocked by levelling the Grekhova to weapon level 20.

Varyana is a mercenary, and member of the Pale Hand. Varyana wields brutal hand-to-hand weapons that are her instruments of carnage; those that come within her grasp fall swiftly. Varyana is the cook of the Pale Hand.
Yang was a Demon Hunter who hailed from Xiansai. He was known for his resourcefulness, his prowess in the multishot technique, and his icy contempt for failure.

EbiBurgamon is a Food Digimon. It is a Digimon that took in food data, and maybe because it consists of the selected ingredient data, it is a Digimon with a pure heart. EbiBurgamon is a variant species of Burgermon, and has taken in the ingredient data of fresh shrimp. It aims to start a first-rate hamburger restaurant that will bring in a lot of customers with Burgermon. Attacks *Fresh Shrimp: Produces a smell savory enough to stop the opponent in their tracks. *Hot Cutlet: Produces a smell savory enough to stop the opponent in their tracks.
The KRS-7.62 is a marksman rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. It was added as part of the Season Four update.

Gankoomon is a Holy Warrior Digimon. It acceded to the "Royal Knights" because it is a Holy Warrior Digimon. Although it is said to have taken up residence in the southwest edges of the Digital World, it rarely stays in the same place, so it journeys across the Digital World while going around and putting a stop to unusual phenomena and signs of chaos, which it learns from Sistermon Ciel's reports, taking along the next-generation Hackmon as its companion; Gankoomon had encountered Hackmon and seen in it the makings of the thirteenth Royal Knight, deciding to temper the Rookie Digimon with frequent, rigorous trials. Unlike the other Royal Knights who rarely show their faces, it actually steps down and acts, it is admired by many Digimon and there are many Digimon it counts as bosom friends. For example, a long time ago, it saved the Sistermon sisters just as they were going to collapse from exhaustion from being out on the streets. In order to pass on its own title as a Royal Knight to Hackmon, it assigns it rigorous trials, and entrusts Hackmon's training to the Sistermon sisters who are accompanying it on the journey; in order to repay Gankoomon for saving them, Sistermon Blanc puts all of its effort into being a chaperone for Hackmon. Due to its stubborn personality, its frequently stern visage and dealing with Hackmon in a severe manner is a cruel sort of kindness of wanting it to keep up with the other Royal Knights and become independent. Gasamon is a Mollusk Digimon. It is a mysterious Digimon with distinctive tentacles who wears a much like a shell, within which it often conceals its weapon. Although it normally disguises itself as a wickerwork hat, when an unsuspecting Digimon approaches, it launches a surprise attack in an attempt to prey on the victim. For this reason, it frequently clashes with BushiAgumon, a Digimon that gets lured in by its desire to wear the hat. However, Gasamon will lose in a direct sword fight, so it quickly runs away if its surprise attack fails. Attacks *: Performs wild slices as it spins its entire body—hat included—round and round. *: Spits out a dissolving liquid from the mouth hidden on its underside, which is thought to be used to melt down victims it has captured for easier consumption.

Fufumon is a Slime Digimon and a carrier of the X Antibody. It has an extremely light body, so it has floated through the air since it was born, but because it floats so slowly, it is easy for opponents to target it. When its life is threatened by an assault from a larger opponent, it will thrust at them with the horn on its head to intimidate them with all its might, but because the horn is very soft, the thrust will not injure the opponent. Attacks * : Spits small iron spikes from its mouth at an approaching opponent.

Gusokumon is a Crustacean Digimon. Gusokumon lurks at the bottom of the ocean, at a depth that light fails to reach. It is also known for being a long-lived Digimon, capable of long-term biological activity while consuming a minuscule amount of energy. Weak, injured Digimon that occasionally sink to the bottom of the ocean turn into its prey. It barely ever moves on its own accord. When facing a large number of enemies, it defends itself by firing countless Colony Torpedoes. Attacks *Brunt Claw: The sharp claws on its forelimbs that it uses to fight back against intruders as they draw near. *Colony Torpedo: Small fish-shaped biological weapons fired from its back. Despite having a slow underwater speed, their nature is similar to that of mines in that they trigger a huge explosion on contact.

Gyuukimon is a Dark Animal Digimon. It is a Digimon with an ox-like upper body and a spider lower body. With a brutal and insidious personality, it is a monster that chases after those who see it for days, and launches surprise attacks from behind every night. Despite its large build, it skillfully uses its spider legs to move quietly without making a sound. The bells hanging from the tips of its horns emit a sound only when it attacks, so those who have seen Gyuukimon will constantly be frightened by the sound of the bells. The dissonance produced by the bells deprives the opponent of their senses, making Gyuukimon's attacks advantageous. Attacks *: Restrains the enemy with a spider thread that it spits out from the mouth of its lower body and then spews a highly toxic liquid. *: Throws the cylinders equipped to its abdomen to spread a poisonous gas. *: Attacks with the weapon on its left arm and ensures that it subdues its prey.
Guidemon is a Guide Digimon that has the appearance of a small floating LCD monitor with arms.
The is a bolt-action sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.

Hyokomon is a Bird Digimon. It digivolved from Chicchimon based on data regarding samurai. It went wandering and trains day and night to perfect the way of the sword, developing new secret sword techniques. Though Hyokomon displays confidence in its swordsmanship, in truth, its actual strength yet lags behind. It's said that the moment its rigorous training leads to breaking out of its shell is the very moment that Hyokomon is ready to digivolve. Attacks *: Uses its wings and leg strength to leap high over its opponent, bringing its sword down upon their head. *: Unleashes a secret technique devised through countless training sessions to quickly knock out any left standing.

Jyarimon is a Slime Digimon. It is an extremely scarce Digimon, whose population is small. The Fresh-levels of Dragon-species Digimon are small in absolute number, and it is said that most of them are captured or die before they grow up. You wouldn't know it to look at it, but there are tiny, closely packed fangs growing within its mouth, and it is foreseen that it will grow into a powerful Dragon-species Digimon. Although it is powerless, it has the disposition to face those with bodies larger than its own, and that becomes the reason for its low survival rate. Attacks *: Attacks with bubbles heated by the constant high temperatures within its body. *: Produces bubbles from its mouth to intimidate the opponent.

KoDokugumon is an Insect Digimon. It is a Rookie Digimon with the appearance of a spider that behaves in clusters with Dokugumon. It is usually docile and hangs from things such as tree branches with its body curled into a ball, but if an enemy approaches, it attacks en masse from overhead. It wears gloves with a strong poison on the claws because it is unable to produce a strong poison of its own yet. Attacks *Poison Nails (Poison Nail): Scratches the enemy with its poison claw gloves.
The or "Unfrocked " was an armored personnel carrier in use with Commonwealth countries during World War II

Kekkomon is a Lesser Digimon. It has a multicolored body. Kekkomon's tongue, a highly-evolved sensory organ, is constantly protruding from its mouth. Whenever an object catches its attention, a single lick allows it to determine detailed information such as its shape, texture, taste, and even its compositional matter. However, possibly due to its developed tongue, its eyesight pales in comparison. Its limbs, although short, allow for nimble movement, making capturing it no easy feat. When attacked by other Digimon, it uses "Beat Lick". Attacks *Beat Lick: Strikes other Digimon with its tongue, then uses the time they're recoiling to scurry away in the blink of an eye.

Keemon is a Slime Digimon. It is an evil-eyed Digimon which is always scowling. Though it's very young, it hates being crowded by others, and lives in hiding. It likes poking its nose out of hiding and harassing with its "Pushū". Attacks *: Spits a stream of water mixed with paint from its mouth.

Lamiamon is a Dragonkin Digimon. It has delightful scales and fins that resemble a dress. Lamiamon is able to produce various types of poisons, some of which are paralytic, with others capable of dissolving solids. Lamiamon's most favored poison gradually drains the life force of its target, and it is said that this Digimon greatly enjoys seeing its enemies suffer. The umbrella it carries is used to store a supply of the poison it generates. A Digimon extremely well-versed in poisons, its sheer expertise enables it to analyze all manner of viral strains. For this reason, Lamiamon is believed to sometimes detoxify poisoned Digimon in exchange for hefty rewards. Attacks *Venombrella (Venobrella): Opens its umbrella, coats it with poison, and deflects attacks while spraying poison to contaminate its surroundings. *Toxin Splash (Splash Toxin): Shoots a fierce stream of poison from the tip of its umbrella, causing instant death to opponents it deems unworthy of the amusement of watching them suffer.

The is a British bolt-action rifle featured in Call of Duty, Call of Duty: United Offensive, Call of Duty: Finest Hour, Call of Duty 2, Call of Duty 3, Call of Duty: Roads to Victory, Call of Duty: World at War (Nintendo DS), Call of Duty: World at War: Final Fronts, Call of Duty: WWII and Call of Duty: Vanguard.

Luxmon is an Angel Digimon. It is a small-bodied, childlike Digimon that belongs to the . Luxmon's innocent nature prevents it from being able to discern truth from lies, which may explain why it is often the target of Impmon and DemiDevimon's teasing. Though not especially powerful in its Rookie form, a group of Luxmon working as a team during battle display a great strength that enables them to take on opponents ostensibly beyond them. It admires Angemon very much. Luxmon can serve as subordinates of ArkhaiAngemon, who protects them and provides support by issuing direct commands. Attacks *Tiny Knuckle (Pico Knuckle): Performs its finest imitation of Angemon's "Hand of Fate". *Cloud Barrier: Deploys a circular shield of light that increases its defensive power by multitudes when several Luxmon use it simultaneously.

Maquinamon is a Composite Digimon. It has both Beast and Machine traits. Although Digimon with mechanical parts are not uncommon, Maquinamon's appearance—perfectly divided between Machine and Beast—is a rarity. The balance between these two traits being unstable, it does not often show emotion nor hostility towards opposing Digimon. Its strength in battle is also lacking, making it vulnerable in the cutthroat environment of the Digital World. Although lacking in emotion, it is faithful to its instincts and has a tremendous appetite; it is thought that this is due to its instability making its metabolism extremely inefficient. However, its animal sense of smell and robotic eyesight make it skilled at finding food, and it is always on the move in search of its next meal. Notably, it is able to change its physiology by gathering data from its surroundings, making it omnivorous and fit for any environment. Attacks *Twin Bubbles: Spits bubbles of fire and electric energy in two rapid bursts, although the bubbles are barely more powerful than those of In-Training Digimon, making them only useful as a distraction.
Mervamon Wide Hi-Vision Sword is a Digimon. It is the DigiFuse of Mervamon, Wisemon, and Hi-VisionMonitamon. Attacks *Mervision Mind Scan: Uses its analysis powers to pinpoint its foe.

Last Bridge Standing is the sixth level in the American campaign of Call of Duty: Finest Hour where Chuck Walker and his squad must capture the bridge alone due to a delay that was placed before their tank support.

Mococomon is a Smoke Digimon. It digivolved from Fukamon, who just drifted aimlessly with the wind, growing fangs and beginning to move more actively. In Shambala, Mococomon is revered as the origin of all Digivolution, and even aggressive Digimon rarely attempt to do it harm. Despite this, it still finds itself in danger from time to time, and when threatened, it uses "Viscous Clouds". Attacks *: Spews out viscous clouds to slow down its opponents' movements, allowing it to escape.

Motimon is a Lesser Digimon. It possesses elastic skin, and is a soft-bodied Digimon that uses the protuberances on the underside of its body to toddle about. It came to be called "Motimon" from inflating its body when it gets worked up, causing it to look like . However, as a result of possessing a height of intelligence that couldn't even be imagined from its appearance, its origin is conjectured to derive from a computer's dictionary feature. It understands human languages, and it is sometimes seen freely deforming its body like it's trying to return communications. Attacks *: Produces -like elastic bubbles to restrict the opponent's movement. *: Spits out bubbles.

Oleamon is a Carnivorous Plant Digimon. It is confirmed to inhabit the forested region of the Digital World. Its flower emits an aroma that lures in Insectoid Digimon. Just as its prey extends its tongue to taste that entrancing aroma, Oleamon's petals capture its target with Jameal. Oleamon are dispersed among other Vegetation Digimon, making it a quietly menacing presence to Insectoid Digimon that live in the same area. Its signature move Leaf Shredder is very versatile. Attacks *Jameal: Slowly digests its prey, with the Digimon it preys on being converted into nourishment. *Leaf Shredder (Leaf Red): Sends its poisonous leaves flying; or bunches them up to act as blades.

The Volkswagen Kübelwagen (short for Kübelsitzwagen, meaning "bucket seat car") was a military vehicle designed by Ferdinand Porsche and built by Volkswagen during World War II for use by the German military (both Wehrmacht and Waffen-SS).

Nosferamon is an Undead Digimon. It has conquered death. Normally, lifeforms in the Digital World are managed by a system that transfers their DigiCores to the Dark Area upon death to be judged for reincarnation. Nosferamon, however, is a unique Digimon that operates outside the boundaries of this system. When the life of a Nosferamon comes to an end, it can transfer its memories and consciousness into the bat-shaped crest on its hat. By engraving this crest on another Digimon, it can then transfer its soul to that Digimon. The DigiCore within the Digimon victim of this transfer is gradually overwritten by the data from the Nosferamon's soul until their body is completely taken over. Digimon engraved with the bat crest will eventually Digivolve into Nosferamon, inheriting all of their experiences and knowledge. It is theorized that Nosferamon's extreme curiosity, desire to understand all worldly matters, and obsession with knowledge gave rise to its ability to circumvent the laws of the Digital World. Defeated Digimon's past memories and experiences spill out from its destroyed DigiCore as so much data, which Nosferamon can then absorb through its mouth to gain new knowledge. It has a long rifle named "Cereza" (). Otamamon X is an Amphibian Digimon and carrier of the X-Antibody. Since its body has become even larger, its vocals have become louder, and the effects of its Special Move "Lullaby Bubble" have strengthened. It is said that because of a certain Mutant-type Mega Digimon, it looked forward to a promising future with its round body and was gifted the gorgeous crown and it became difficult to be attacked by the enemy due to its majestic appearance. Furthermore, it also taught Otamamon its Signature Move "Smiley Headbutt". Attacks *Lullaby Bubble: Sends the opponent into an eternal slumber. *Smiley Headbutt: Headbutts the enemy without breaking its smile, but its face still cramps up and its power is weak.

Palmon X is a Plant Digimon and carrier of the X-Antibody. The glamorous, tropical flower on its head has fully bloomed, and its colors and fragrance now express Palmon's emotions clearly. It releases a poisonous scent from its red petals when angry, a cool scent that suppresses the enemy's fighting spirit from its blue-green petals when sad, and a scent that plunges nearby Digimon into a hallucination, causing them to escape from reality, from its yellow petals when happy. The essences of these scents are blended within its body to produce its "RGB Herb". Digimon scratched by the claws on its arms would be temporarily confused due to the poison it synthesizes. Attacks *Poison Ivy: Entangles the opponent in ivy laced with a powerful toxin. If you suffer this attack, your body will be completely paralyzed. * Herb
Leadfoot is a vehicle perk in Call of Duty: World at War that increases a tank's top speed by 35%.
Pekomon is a Compression Appmon. An Appmon with the ability to compress data. Any Appmon hit by its hammer is reduced to a cute miniature size. Attacks * *Hammer Smash (Peko Smash)

Pabumon is a Slime Digimon. Although it looks like it is just pale green bubbles at first glance, it is a Bubble Digimon that can move freely and express a plethora of facial expressions. Because its surface has not hardened yet, its defensive power is nonexistent and it is equally unsuited for combat. From the portion that looks like a pacifier held in its mouth, it generates tiny bubbles, and proliferates them infinitely. As for that proliferation, at one point, it started being used for computer virus development, but because its life force was too weak, that was fortunately never implemented. Although its life is fleeting, it is a lovable Digimon Baby that lives earnestly. Attacks *: Escapes while the intruder's movement is restricted by the adhesive bubbles it generates from within its body. *: Produces bubbles from its mouth to intimidate the opponent.

Pinamon is a Bird Digimon. It always runs about restlessly. Because it expresses its emotions in how it runs, it doesn't stand still unless it is bored or sleeping. Because its emotions do not appear on its face, its emotions must be read from how it runs, so making a connection with it is very difficult. Although Pinamon hates its tails being touched, just like Puwamon, more caution is needed when touching them than with Puwamon, due to its "Piripiri Spark". Attacks *: Generates a miniature electric shock from its tails.

The L86 LSW, referred to as SA80 in the game files, is a bullpup light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Call of Duty Online, Call of Duty: Mobile, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered.

RareRaremon is an Undead Digimon. It is the Ultimate of Raremon who has survived the advanced decay of its body through further mechanization and has taken on a bizarre appearance. Its body repeatedly breaks down and takes form, and eyes and mouths have emerged which are rotting away. The foul stench it gives off from its entire body has increased so much that even Megas have difficulty approaching it. Because it consumes energy to maintain its body, it makes up for that energy by dissolving the enemy with its "Digestion" (Digest). Attacks *Digestion (Digest): Dissolves the enemy after it swallows them whole via the mouth on its head. *Decayson: Toxic gas spewed out of its many mouths. Enemies that inhale it die instantly.

Puyomon is a Slime Digimon. It is a soft and sticky Digimon that is found in the "Net Ocean." Its singular lens lacks emotional expression so you can't really tell what it's thinking, and it floats in the sky and sea and tries to stick to objects and other Digimon with its tentacles. Attacks *: When it sticks to things, it emits a tingling static electricity which is not actually an attack, but seems to be a form of communication unique to Puyomon. When multiple Puyomon stick to each other, their Pachi Pachi Gas becomes more powerful, making it difficult to approach the surrounding area.

Pupumon is a Slime Digimon and a carrier of the X Antibody. It has grown a body as light as a bubble, as well as very thin wings and somewhat largish eyes which are very sensitive to movement. If something moves, Pupumon will notice it and immediately spring away, but this doesn't mean it's a coward, as, if the object continues to be unkind and approaches, Pupumon will counterattack. Attacks *: Spits poisonous bubbles from its mouth at the opponent.
The is a bolt-action sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Black Ops Declassified, Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, and Call of Duty: Mobile.

Puwamon is a Bird Digimon. It is covered in soft down. Its eyesight is extremely great, and because it is able to survey a vast range, it can react instantly to surrounding movements. Its personality is intensely curious, and it began gaining popularity because it lacks shyness and easily makes attachments. However, it extremely dislikes when its tail is touched, and so if its tail is touched carelessly, caution is necessary because it will shower you in blinding down. Attacks *: Showers the opponent in blinding down.

Salamon X is a Mammal Digimon and carrier of the X-Antibody. Its cuteness as a pet that gives feelings of happiness to those who see it has increased. Not only that, but its holy power has also increased, and after Salamon walked, it acquired its "Puppy Paw" technique. Attacks *Puppy Howl (Puppy Howling): A super-high pitched bark, it completely paralyzes the opponent. *Puppy Paw: Forms a barrier against Virus-species, however, it is not aware of it itself.

The is a family of aquatic serpent Digimon who each have the suffix "-Seadramon" in their name. Aegisdramon was born from the fusion of a Plesiomon with Seadramon-species data. MetalSeadramon is considered their final form.

Private Krol (Polish: King) was a soldier in the 1st Polish Division. He is seen in a tank in the mission, The Mace. It was destroyed later by the Germans while on its the way up the hill. However, Krol survives the explosion, and is next seen with Gorski after Leslie Baron's death. He dies in the explosion that kills Joakim Rudinski and Gorski.

Suzumon is a Lesser Digimon. Its body rings like a small chime with each step it takes. Sensitive to imminent danger, when this Digimon feels threatened, it shakes its body to emit a sharp sound to warn others. Having one as a companion could make traveling a little bit safer. Attacks *: Bludgeons foes with its tail, producing a light tinkling sound that is at odds with the fierce attack.

Zerimon is a Slime Digimon. Zerimon and Conomon are extremely rare Digimon, which are born in pairs from a single . Why only Zerimon and Conomon are born as twins is not clearly known at the present stage. What is more, they are not restricted to always being born as twins, and either a Zerimon or Conomon may be born from a single Digi-Egg. Compared to the extremely energetic, one-horned Zerimon, the three-horned Conomon has a relatively docile personality. Also, unlike other Slime Digimon, Zerimon is perfectly firm other than just the horn on its head. Like other Fresh Digimon, it spits acid bubbles to intimidate opponents. Attacks *: Spits acid bubbles to intimidate the opponent.

Yolkmon is a Slime Digimon. It is still wearing the shell from its on its head. It is laid-back in nature and makes a life for itself slipping into the nests of other Digimon. As the Digi-Egg shell acts as camouflage, Yolkmon is hardly ever spotted before it Digivolves. In the unlikely event that Yolkmon is discovered by a threat, it can use "Bubbles". Attacks *: Produces bubbles from its body to intimidate other Digimon.

The L118A is a bolt-action sniper rifle that appears in Find Makarov: Operation Kingfish, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It was first shown during footage at the Call of Duty XP event.
Zenzu is a Digital Lifeform. It resembles a bluish-white human soul. It and Akuzu float by Enmamon's side as its familiars and inscribe DigiCore information onto scrolls for Enmamon to examine.

The or LCI is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One and Call of Duty: World at War. There were several classes of seagoing amphibious assault ships used to land large numbers of infantry directly onto beaches, some models were equipped with rocket launchers. They were commonly used in amphibious invasions during World War II, in battles like the Battle of Peleliu, Operation Husky, Battle of Okinawa and the Normandy Landings.

"You should not let his location be discovered, you have failed us" - the Demonic Voice voices his anger for Olivia Pierce's incompetency to keep the location of the Doom Slayer a secret. The Demonic Voice is an unseen demon lord that appears during the Doom Slayer's quest to release the souls of the Wraiths. Nothing is known about the Demonic Voice but it is indicated that it has a very high rank in Hell as it can command lesser demons to hinder the Doom Slayer in his quest. Olivia Pierce was also shown to interact with the Demonic Voice when it expressed disappointment that she was unable to stop Samuel Hayden from discovering the tomb of the Doom Slayer.
Sam (aka SAM), is a flying drone bot in Doom Resurrection, capable of opening doors and hacking computers.
Ostrich Chickens are a race of bird creatures that are effectively the same as ostriches.

The Iveco LMV is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts. It appears in the multiplayer map Whiteout, in the missions No Man's Land and Clockwork plus in the Extinction mission Exodus. There is also an unused open topped model with a roll cage in the game files that matches the Iveco LMV Special Forces variant.
Salusan tiger was a fierce wild creature of Salusa Secundus.

Changelings are a fey or humanoid race who are related to doppelgangers and share their shapeshifting qualities and capacity for disguise. This makes them effective as actors, spies, and criminals, which has in turn led to them being mistrusted amongst the people of Khorvaire. They are sometimes also known as doppelgangers themselves.
Ardras d'Jorasco is a halfling adept who is particularly devoted to Olladra and a healer of House Jorasco.

The Laser Turret is a futuristic form of portable artillery used in an anti-aircraft and anti-missile role that appears in Call of Duty: Black Ops II and Call of Duty: Heroes. As the name suggests, powerful lasers are mounted on a trailer and fired at incoming threats. Warning stickers on the side indicate that organic matter is vaporized upon coming into contact with the laser beam.
Caerzaal is a former paladin of the Silver Flame of Thrane who converted to the Blood of Vol and became a vampire and member of the Emerald Claw.

Alina Lorridan Lyrris is a wealthy gnome and accomplished wizard who made her fortune off of the Khyber dragonshards harvested from her family's gem mine in Zilargo. She is a Platinum Concordian in the Aurum who sits on the Shadow Cabinet. She was nicknamed "Khyber's Daughter" by a writer for the Korranberg Chronicle for her love of chaos as much as the dragonshards.
Basilisks are multi-legged reptiles with the ability to petrify creatures. The basilisk is the symbol of House Medani.
The L115 is a bolt-action sniper rifle that appears in Call of Duty: Ghosts and Call of Duty Online.
Bredoln Laranak is a dwarf of the Laranak clan in the Mror Holds now living in Stormreach in Xen'drik. He is a noted local arm wrestler.
Addis-Ro was a giant wizard-king who once reigned in Xen'drik.

Avassh, known as the Twister of Roots, is a daelkyr who is known to still exist on Eberron through their cults and legends, being said to lurk in the depths of Khyber. Avassh is said to be responsible for the creation of shambling mounds and myconids, though it is thought that they may also be responsible for any unnatural and deadly vegetation.
Koi Personalization Pack is a downloadable content package available for Call of Duty: Ghosts. It contains a weapon camo, reticle, a player background and a player patch.
Aussircaex is a white dragon who lives in Xen'drik and Everice. She has the dubious honor of having been repeatedly saved by the Savior of Korthos.
Doppelgangers are monstrous humanoids infamous for their innate shapeshifting abilities, which allow them to mimic almost any humanoid creature.

Donata is the self-proclaimed empress of a small, secret society of magebred humanoids. Their feudal society is loosely based on some notion of superiority they hold amongst themselves. They are based in the Royal Palaces of Vermishard in the ruins of Metrol in the Mournland. They perpetuate the myth of the spirits and "ghostbeasts" that stalk the ruins.
The L85 is a bullpup assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It was also cut from Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, and appears very briefly in Call of Duty: Black Ops II.

Cloakers are large aberrations named for their resemblance to leathery cloaks. They are ambush predators that use their natural camouflage to surprise prey. Cloakers are found in Khyber. Like other aberrations, cloakers are suspected to be spawn of the daelkyr.

Dulazurak was a powerful dragon from the Age of Demons and the archetype of the dishonorable warrior in the draconic Thir faith, that is, the traitor's path of the wyrm of war archetype. As such, Dulazurak is equated with the Mockery, who in turn is represented as a half-fiend red dragon.

Flinds are humanoid creatures related to gnolls. They are particularly strong and vicious gnolls that can command their war band. While flinds are admired and respected by their lesser cousins, there is no love in the end for the superior breed. If not found in a leadership role over other gnolls, flinds often wind up as solitary hunters.

The (KPA; Korean: 조선인민군; Hanja: 朝鮮人民軍; MR: Chosŏn inmin'gun) encompasses the combined military forces of North Korea. They are featured in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.
Fritz Fitzwood was a human werewolf who was a ward of the Sanctuary within the Catacombs, the Church of the Silver Flame's temple in Stormreach.

Jaela Daran is an eleven-year-old human girl who serves as the Keeper of the Flame, the spiritual leader of the Church of the Silver Flame. She lives in the Cathedral of the Silver Flame in Flamekeep, Thrane. She is one of the strongest clerics on Eberron, but has to stay near Flamekeep with the Silver Flame in order to receive her great powers.

Haestus d'Cannith was once an amateur necromancer and the overseer of a House Cannith facility before his death at the hands of a Karrnathi raiding party. Haestus returned from the dead as a forgewraith, and still haunts his old facility.
Lagoon Camouflage is a weapon camouflage in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. It is available with the purchase of the Lagoon Pack. Lagoon Personalization Pack AW.jpg|The Lagoon Pack poster.
Hadozee, also known as deck apes or winged deck apes, are an extremely rare kind of simian humanoid with distinctive patagia known for their love of sailing and of their ships.
Hes is a changeling wererat and member of the Bilge Rats in Stormreach.
The shulassakar are a rare psionic race of monstrous humanoids resembling feathered serpentfolk. They superficially resemble the yuan-ti, with whom they may share some distant relation and animosity.

The LZ-52 Limbo is a directed energy weapon available in the Exo Zombies map Carrier as part of the Supremacy downloadable map pack. The gun fires a small ball from the barrel of the gun, where it proceeds to create a long laser beam across the room and slices the zombie's corpse. It is a one hit kill until round 12 when not upgraded. After that it makes crawlers. The weapon features an eight round rotating cylinder in the gun's body, functioning somewhat like a revolver, and has full mobility.

A decorated veteran of World War III, Martel's unit, the Escadron Lafayette, specializes in precision airstrikes on enemy ground units. Martel's flight of Eurofighter Hailstorms is equipped with dual-purpose ground attack missiles that are designed to engage both armored and soft-skinned targets. Air strike-1402986195.png|Eurofighter Hailstorm

Due to a shortage of qualified pilots at the end of the war, Izmailov found himself commanding a flight of Su-38 Slamhounds in the 403rd Ground Attack Squadron at the very young age of 23, and was tasked with flying ground support missions for anti-bandit operations in Southern Russia. He and his pilots soon became experts in precision ground attacks, flying at high speed through the mountainous terrain to avoid enemy Surface-to-Air missiles.

Denoas is a background character from TearRing Saga: Utna Heroes Saga. He was an official of the then newly formed Republic of Reeve, which was founded by settlers from the eastern continent of Jugd. He began an extermination of the native Zoans in response to their attack against Reeve. Within only five years, he managed to conquer all of the Zoan clans, who feared him due to his merciless massacre of their people.
The Kuda is a submachine gun that appears in Call of Duty: Black Ops III.

Ena is a playable character from Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance and Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn. Despite being technically classified as a Red Dragon, her scales are pink in color, and she is characterized by relatively high magic stats. This is a result of the White Dragon blood that she has received from her grandfather, Nasir.

Farina is a playable character from Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade. She is a famed member of the 3rd Wing of Ilia's Pegasus Knights. She is the middle sister of Fiora and Florina. She only appears in Hector's Tale and joins in that version of the story.

Graff is a boss character from TearRing Saga: Berwick Saga. He and his older twin brother Griff lead the Muthay Gang, a group of bandits that have been terrorizing the eastern roads into Narvia. He is the stronger, but dumber, of the two.
The L-CAR 9 is a fully-automatic pistol featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III and Call of Duty: Mobile.

Harrington is a boss character from TearRing Saga: Berwick Saga. He is one of the leaders of the Neam Bandits, and an alcoholic. A vile murderer, he's known to have personally beat at least 50 people to death, putting him on the Narvia Mercenary Guild's rogues gallery.

Griss is a character from Fire Emblem Engage. He is a member of the Four Hounds, an organization that plans to revive the Fell Dragon. He is a violent, insane, and dangerous magician. An alternate universe counterpart of him exists known as Gregory.
Heath is a playable character from Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade. He is a proud Wyvern Rider of Bern who is honorable with a strong sense of justice and morality.

The Laser Trap is a utility in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare on the Exo Zombies maps Outbreak, Carrier and Descent. In Outbreak when activated, the room with Exo Suits will have several lasers horizontally along the floor, killing zombies that walk through them; there is a chance a crawler will be made however. There are other laser traps located throughout the map, some located at chest level, providing a more effective way to kill zombies. In Carrier, the only laser trap can be found in the Bio-Lab whereas in Descent, it can be found in the Galleria, near the Exo Suits.
